mapper.sql: k.organization_uuid, k.prompt_uuid, k.key, k.value, CAST(k.version AS text) AS version_json, k.created_at, k.updated_at
mapper.insert: WITH target_prompt AS ( SELECT uuid FROM workbench_prompts WHERE organization_uuid = #{params.OrganizationUUID} AND prompt_uuid = #{params.PromptUUID} LIMIT 1 ) INSERT INTO workbench_prompt_kv ( organization_uuid, prompt_ref_uuid, prompt_uuid, key, value, version, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{params.OrganizationUUID}, target_prompt.uuid, #{params.PromptUUID}, #{params.Key}, #{params.Value,sensitive=true}, CAST(#{params.VersionJSON,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM target_prompt ON CONFLICT (organization_uuid, prompt_ref_uuid, key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, version = EXCLUDED.version, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
